describes: kosha-client (Python): its translation of OpenSearch / Elasticsearch request bodies into Kosha's native /v1 API, and how that API answers them. Kosha has no server-side OpenSearch endpoint (_search, _bulk). The TypeScript and Go SDKs send native /v1 bodies only and do not translate the DSL.

cases.note: Inside a bool next to other clauses it adds nothing, as in Elasticsearch.
cases.divergence: On its own (and likewise a body with no `query`) it matches no documents, so aggregations over it are empty too: the translator drops it, and a Kosha search with neither query text nor a filter matches nothing. Write it as a filter, `{"bool": {"filter": [{"match_all": {}}]}}`, to match every document.
